subject: Can't connect new sensor to Wi-Fi during setup
body:
Just got a new VestaGuard for my basement furnace. The app sees the device in setup mode (blinking blue) but when I enter my Wi-Fi password it fails after about 30 seconds with 'Could not join network'.

My network is 'Tran-5G' and the password works on my phone. Router is an Eero 6.

What am I doing wrong?

-Mike
